description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'RadioGroup1' that demonstrates the usage of RadioGroup, including programmatic addition of radio buttons, listening to checked change events, and clearing selections via a button.

classes.name: RadioGroup1
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating the use of RadioGroup with programmatic radio button addition, change handling, and clearing selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, adds a radio button programmatically, sets listeners, and initializes the UI.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles checked change events for the RadioGroup, updating the display based on which radio button is selected.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for the clear button, clearing the radio button selection.
